response.justification: Bogdan has broad engineering experience across languages and domains, with notable open-source contributions and deep systems knowledge, but lacks explicit, recent experience with Java/Kotlin IDE tooling, Spring, or JVM internals — core requirements for this role. His DLang and TypeScript focus, while impressive, doesn't align tightly with the job's enterprise JVM tooling focus.
strengths: Strong open-source contributions with complex systems (GISCollective, Fluent-Asserts)
Proven ability to work across stacks and languages with deep systems understanding
Demonstrated passion for developer tooling and education through workshops and talks
concerns: No visible recent experience with Java, Kotlin, Spring, or JVM-based IDE tooling
Primary tech stack in recent roles is TypeScript/Node.js and DLang, not JVM ecosystem
Lack of documented work on build tools, application servers, or IDE internals
